body: If you live in Hall Green, your dog groomer is on your doorstep. Keith's K9 Care is right here on Castle Meadows — the same WF4 3QJ postcode as most of the neighbourhood — so there's no travel and no fuss. Plenty of Hall Green dogs simply walk down for their grooms and walk home again looking smart.

Being a home salon in the heart of the village is the whole point. Your dog is the only one in the room — no kennels, no other dogs barking through the wall, no production line. One dog, one groomer, one quiet space, worked at your dog's pace. It's exactly the calm, local setup that nervous dogs, puppies and older dogs do best in.

Keith is IPET-qualified, trained at Mrs B's in Leeds, and grooms every coat type — full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath and tidy, nail trims, de-matting and traditional hand stripping. Prices are published in full with breed examples, and confirmed in person before he starts.

As your most local groomer, Keith is happy to be flexible on timing — a quick call, WhatsApp or message and he'll find a slot. Many Hall Green customers become regulars on a standing six-week appointment.

faqs.q: Where exactly in Hall Green is the salon?
faqs.a: 4 Castle Meadows, Hall Green, Wakefield WF4 3QJ — a purpose-built home salon in a converted garage, two minutes from Newmillerdam Country Park.

faqs.q: Can my dog walk to their groom in Hall Green?
faqs.a: Most can — we're right in the village, so plenty of Hall Green dogs walk down. A walked-out dog often settles better for a groom, too.

faqs.q: Are you taking on new Hall Green customers?
faqs.a: Yes — give Keith a call, WhatsApp or message and he'll find you a slot. Lots of local dogs are on a regular six-week cycle.
